suggested_requirements.text: The system shall run on a fully relational, SQL-based database system.
The system shall allow running SQL queries against any table in the database.
The system shall provide real-time processing for library operations.
The system shall allow multiple staff and patrons to simultaneously access and update patron and item records.
The system shall allow staff to identify where a patron or item record is in use.
The system shall support individual and shared staff login accounts with role-based access control.
The system shall provide access to all configuration files.
The system shall provide full access to all log files.
The system shall provide access to the root shell.
The system shall support the creation of custom dashboards for system performance and data monitoring.
The system shall support SNMP for monitoring system resources.
The system shall allow administrators to set thresholds for record locks and unlock records.
The system shall provide a server management console for software and server startup, shutdown, and restart.
The system shall provide a management console for monitoring client workstations and sessions.
The system shall provide a circulation dashboard showing key performance indicators.
The system shall provide a single interface for reviewing and controlling scheduled tasks.
The system shall support SMTP for email transport.
The system shall enforce business rules for record deletion based on status.
The system shall provide customizable rules of suppression for record visibility.
The system shall allow creation and modification of rules for placing holds on items.
The system shall allow creation and modification of loan rules for check-out, loan periods, and renewals.
The system shall allow specification of default values, data validation, and required status for any field.
The system shall perform live incremental and full backups of data and transaction logs.
The system shall provide undo functionality for data changes.
The system shall support server clustering for failover capability.
The system shall support secure protocols including SFTP, SSL, and SSH.
The system shall support batch import and export of MARC bibliographic and authority records.
The system shall support the creation and management of record sets for batch operations.
The system shall provide a dedicated interface for creating and managing staff accounts.
The system shall provide a dedicated interface for creating and managing patron accounts.
The system shall support administrator and user-programmable keyboard macros and shortcuts.
The system shall support centrally managed client software installation and updates.
The system shall allow full customization of report layout and appearance.
The system shall provide a user-friendly interface for designing queries against all record types.
The system shall allow administrators to create report templates for staff use.
The system shall provide fine-grained permissions for running reports.
The system shall support four types of printers: receipt, standard, label, and forms.
The system must support 50 locations, 20 million circulations, and 500,000 items per year.
Searches and reports should be processed during open hours without disrupting other system functions.
The system shall operate on a Linux or Solaris server.
